verdict.rationale: GitHub offers CI/CD through GitHub Actions (github-docs-11, github-docs-38), but no first-party doc in the pack describes self-hosted or private runners. The only direct reference is an older community comment saying GitHub 'still lacks self-hosted runners for organizations' (github-comm-20), which implies runners exist below the org level but are limited for teams. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of self-hosted runners, org- and enterprise-level runner management, private networking options, and current hands-on corroboration.
